sentences.text:
Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma
Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1072 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt Avani Tiwari

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Prakash Dwivedi,Pranshu Dwivedi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Complaint Case No. 428 of 2019 arising out of Case Crime No. 248 of 2015, under sections 420,
406, 506 IPC, Police Station- Kotwali, District- Jhansi.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that she is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

In this case, there was an agreement between the co-accused and the informant for purchase of a land and condition was that if within six months, sale deed was not got executed by the informant the advance will be forfeited.

The informant did not got sale deed executed within the aforesaid period, as a result the advance was forfeited regarding which a civil suit no. 260 of 2015 was filed by the informant against the applicant which is still pending but later on in the year 2016 Smt Avani Tiwari vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103585834/
1 present F.I.R. was lodged by the informant against the applicant in which during investigation no offence was found to be made out against her as a result final report was submitted by the police in which protest was filed by the informant which was treated as complaint and after recording the statement of the informant under Section 200 Cr.P.C. summoning order was passed by the learned court vide order dated 16.12.2019, when this fact came into knowledge of this applicant, she moved anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Smt Avani Tiwari vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that dispute between the parties is of civil nature regarding which civil suit is still pending in which rights of the parties are to be determined.
She is ready to face the trial, therefore, requested for anticipatory bail during pendency of trial.
Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

On considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perusal of record, there appears ground to grant anticipatory bail in favour of applicant during pendency of trial.

The applicant Smt Avani Tiwari shall be released on anticipatory bail during pendency of trial on furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the learned trial court unless exempted;

( ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police office;

(iii) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if she has passport, the same shall be deposited by her before the S.S.P./S.P.
concerned.
In default of any of the conditions, this bail order shall stand automatically vacated.

Order Date :- 21.4.2023 A. Singh  Smt Avani Tiwari vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103585834/
